entries.name: SP-VID-101-ANIME4UP
entries.releaseNotes: 1.0.0-beta.10: Fixes episodes that ended with no playable servers. The module read JSON responses through text(), and the app runtime returns an EMPTY text() for JSON (the parsed value is only exposed through json()) - so every Share4Max mirror list was lost, and only the HTML-based hosts could ever play. JSON is now read through json(); the Share4Max payload parser also accepts both payload shapes, and its phase is bounded to 9s so it cannot spend the whole episode budget.

entries.name: SP-VID-101-ANIME4UP
entries.releaseNotes: 1.0.0-beta.10: Fixes episodes that ended with no playable servers. The module read JSON responses through text(), and the app runtime returns an EMPTY text() for JSON (the parsed value is only exposed through json()) - so every Share4Max mirror list was lost, and only the HTML-based hosts could ever play. JSON is now read through json(); the Share4Max payload parser also accepts both payload shapes, and its phase is bounded to 9s so it cannot spend the whole episode budget.
